name: flutter_test
summary: Flutter SDK testing support for widget tests and Flutter-specific test utilities.
advantages: Provides WidgetTester, finders, widget matchers, and testWidgets
Fast feedback compared with full integration tests
tradeoffs: Does not validate the complete application on a real target device
Native platform UI interaction requires different or additional testing approaches
recommendedFor: Flutter unit tests needing Flutter bindings or matchers
Testing presentation logic and widgets without full-device integration testing

verification.reason: Flutter official widget-testing documentation is sufficient.
